planning.teacherObjective: Tulkita muuttuva liike paikka–aika-kuvaajasta ja tasavälisistä ajanmerkeistä.
planning.scope: Finite nonnegative 1D velocity timelines, positive direction and origin0. Exact piecewise integration yields genuinely quadratic position paths, linear velocity, world/readout/strobes/table. Explicit axes/controls/units/ranges. Unsupported semantics rejected. At nondifferentiable phase joins acceleration is null. Every integer annotation/table value exact rational; moving live readouts labelled approximations.
planning.sourceVsDesign: Frozen metadata inherited, no new OPH verification. Physics/mathematics deterministic; narrative, examples, sequencing, support are project pedagogical derivations/hypotheses. Human learner, efficacy, full accessibility/VoiceOver, rights/public release remain separate holds.
planning.evidenceLimits: Process role preserved. Local graph explanation and phase practice do not award formal process/rubric mastery, independence or delayed evidence. Help/examples/feedback are instructional support. No personal history or runtime LLM.

extensions.modelDeclarationSource: Bundled MODELS is the single executable typed source; all accepted semantics implemented, unknown semantics fail closed. No duplicated ignored simulation metadata.
extensions.assessmentDeclarationSource: TASKS generic finite operations motion/change/sign/mean_a/compare_a/phases. No KC-ID or question-specific truth branches.
extensions.authoringLimits: Selfcontained bundle no imports/storage/LLM. Exact answers<=128rawchars, up to12 meaningful decimal places, fractions; time control<=6meaningful decimals. One-second strobes only supported, reject others. Own article root/per-host ownership, explicit cleanup/pause/reset.
